messages.subject: error when ruing nimbleMCMC
parts:

messages.author: b580f6ffa202c87e
messages.subject: Re: error when ruing nimbleMCMC
parts: This has happened to me before. It was because of not having Rtools installed. If you do not have it installed, then that may be the issue but I'm not aware of any other reason.
